ilasmDotnet.dotnetPath.description: Path to the dotnet host used to run the ILASM Dotnet engine.

ilasmDotnet.enginePath.description: Absolute path to the ILASM Dotnet engine. Either a published executable or the IlasmDotnet.Engine.dll to run with dotnet. Empty means use the bundled/built copy.

ilasmDotnet.includeCompilerGenerated.description: Show compiler generated types and members (state machines, lambdas) in the decompiled C# view.

ilasmDotnet.syncOriginalSource.description: Highlight the original source lines that correspond to the IL instruction under the caret.

ilasmDotnet.syncScroll.description: Scroll a linked view or the source file to the highlighted code while the caret moves. The scroll happens only when the match is outside the visible part.

ilasmDotnet.maxAssembliesPerProject.description: Maximum number of build outputs to discover per project.

ilasmDotnet.asmOptimized.description: Ask the JIT for optimized (FullOpts) native code instead of tier 0 code. Ignored for assemblies built with [Debuggable], which cannot be optimized.

ilasmDotnet.ilasmPath.description: Path to ilasm. Leave empty to use the assembler shipped with the extension, the NuGet cache or PATH.

ilasmDotnet.nativeIncludeRuntime.description: List the methods of the runtime with the application's own when a NativeAOT image is read. An AOT image holds the code of the framework it was built with, which is thousands of methods the reader did not write.

ilasmDotnet.asmSource.description: Where the native code comes from: an attached process (always wins), the image itself (ReadyToRun), or the JIT of this machine.

ilasmDotnet.assemblies.description: Assemblies and native images to list in the tree in addition to the build outputs found in the workspace.

keybindings.when: editorLangId == csharp || editorLangId == fsharp || editorLangId == vb

scripts.build:engine: dotnet publish engine/IlasmDotnet.Engine/IlasmDotnet.Engine.csproj -c Release -o out/engine -p:UseAppHost=false -p:DebugType=none -p:GenerateDocumentationFile=false && node scripts/copy-ilasm.mjs
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && tsc src/viewer/mapping.ts src/viewer/viewSession.ts src/engine/protocol.ts --outDir out/test --module commonjs --target es2022 --skipLibCheck
scripts.test: node --test scripts/manifest.test.mjs scripts/mapping.test.mjs scripts/viewsession.test.mjs && node scripts/extension.test.mjs && node scripts/smoke.mjs
scripts.check: npm run compile && npm run build:engine && npm test
scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run build:engine && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true })" && vsce package --out dist/ilasm-dotnet-1.0.0.vsix
